task.title: Persist request proof eligibility and preserve conservative Cursor holds
task.body:
## Context and outcome
Establish durable main-turn-end eligibility independently from nullable child identity, preserving historical non-Cursor behavior and conservative old/new unknown Cursor origin. Add the guarded next hop from v10 with fresh convergence if needed; preserve narrow Cursor lifecycle holds/report acceptance including concurrent insertion and unchanged Claude/Codex Stop waiting. No actual request admission. Maps E2 AC7; SR4.1/4.2, SR5.2, SR9.1.

## Execution boundary
User authorizes only E2 in current feature/b.ftd worktree. Local conventional commits scope b.jf1, never push. Source Engineer, fixtures/tests TestWriter, prose DocWriter; root commits/statuses. Execute all repo artifacts via sandbox only, never real AD stores or Cursor credentials. Actual heavy Docker/TLC commands handed to user for scheduler at exact local commit, never local execution. Follow engineering/test/doc/migration guides and preserve other-agent/public controls/gates; no screen-derived state or new public approval API.

## Run Integration After This Task
Interface changed: permission-request schema, construction/materialization, main-turn proof eligibility and Cursor lifecycle-held reporting.

## Test Writer Lanes
Suggested lanes: 1
- Lane 1: migration/store/hook/API/formal behavioral owners; installer pin/literal recovery synchronization follows canonical prose.
Shared fixtures or helpers: migration_fixtures/versioned DB; moveHome/migLay/rollbackReleasedPair; relayReq/mainReq/storefix.SeedRelayRequest/SeedDecideFixtureAgent/newPAEnvAgent/hook fixtures; Hold36hCx configs. No new collector in Task1; cursor-relay authoring later must include migration/proof predicates.
Final full sandbox unit subtask belongs to no lane.

## Canonical recovery synchronization
One initial DocWriter pass follows settled source and behavioral tests. Installer literal recovery pins follow the settled three-way prose, then sole final TestWriter runs full units. Documentation depends on preceding behavioral tests; installer-pin test depends on migration-doc subtask. No duplicate doc pass or manufactured full-suite failure against intentionally stale pins.

subtasks.title: Establish durable proof eligibility and its migration
subtasks.body:
## Context
RequestProof.match currently treats NULL agent_id as main-turn eligibility, conflating unknown Cursor origin with proven main.

## What Needs to Change
Introduce explicit durable eligibility independent of child identity. Preserve historical semantics, conservative unknown/child Cursor values and compatible reentry. If persistence changes, add a guarded v10-to-next hop and matching fresh DDL, preserving previous hops and all rows/identity.

## Key Files
- internal/store/schema.go; internal/store/store.go; internal/store/permission.go; internal/store/relay_writes.go; migration owner beside these.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Fresh/migrated semantics converge; eligible historical main remains eligible and child remains ineligible; unknown/null-child Cursor stays ineligible after reopen; transactional failure/retry and authorization/data/store-ID preservation; explicit false survives reentry.
 Preserve historical non-Cursor main/child semantics; do not invent proven-main origin for historical or new Cursor unknown-origin records. Explicit false survives compatible reentry/reopen.
Cursor Stop/Interrupt/working preserve genuine check_permission holds including concurrent insertion; report success requires existing matching ownership/session/runtime. Claude/Codex Stop waiting with child holds remains unchanged.
